info.name: Agent1o1 API
info.description:
Full REST API for the Agent1o1 workflow automation & AI agent platform (Laravel + Passport).

- Auth: OAuth2 password grant via Passport, exposed as simple email/password login returning `access_token` / `refresh_token`. The **Login** request under Auth auto-populates the `access_token` / `refresh_token` collection variables.
- Most endpoints are workspace-scoped: set `workspace_id` after creating/selecting a workspace.
- Base URL defaults to `http://localhost:8000`; override `base_url` per environment.

request.description: Signed URL delivered in the verification email. `id` and `hash` come from that link — do not hand-craft them.
Hit by the OAuth provider after user consent; not called directly by clients.
Called by Stripe only. Signed via the `Stripe-Signature` header — do not call manually outside testing.
Also accepts GET. `webhookUuid` is the trigger's public webhook id from Trigger.store response.
Resumes a paused execution waiting on `flow.wait_for_event` / manual approval. Also accepts GET.
On success, saves `access_token` / `refresh_token` into collection variables (see Tests tab) so subsequent requests authenticate automatically.
